Grenades that can be placed on your chest. Perfect for quick access – at least, they would be if you ever remembered to use these ones instead of the ones in your pocket.

Impact Shin Pads. Ever notice nobody in this city opens doors with their hands? The old ‘feet-first meet-and-greet’? When your shin armor looks this good who can blame you for wanting them to be the first thing people see of you?

These Cherub Wings might not save you from taking falling damage, but they will save your heart from being broken.
This diamond design holster in red and white from Villainy is definitely a girl's best friend - it features easy access and a smooth drawing action all without bulking out your figure.

Infamy's holsters were ideal for wasting 'Forcers, but only looked good on guys. After a moderately violent customer campaign they created this. It is a new kind of holster for the female form and emphasizes your waist.
Birth's catalog labels this, in a rather perfunctory manner, as the B-247 double holster. The Blood Rose girls soon renamed it 'the twins'.
When Birth was approached to create a new shoulder harness for a knife, the reply was 'only if you can see it from every angle'. But that suits us just fine.
This knife sheath was inspired by the Tanto weaponry of the Samurai, the result of another Suji and Jean Zasou team-up.
Flower Power! Skin Deco double back holster, in delicious '60s flavors. Free love not included.
A member of Shadow Strike is now missing their favorite knife sheath harnes... What a shame. And we've gone and gotten paint all over it, too. Nice of them to break it in for you, though.
Arlon needs you to be alert at all times. That means keeping you in the loop. That's why he's rolling out high-tech ordnance to all of the top brass.
Top of the line Zoosh knife sheath. Platinum-gold alloy on the buckles, making this one priceless. Arlon commissioned a similar one as a birthday gift for his little girl.
A military-style webbed midriff holster. Perfect for storing ammo, makeup, weaponry, fingers saved as trophies and so on. Hell, put whatever you like in there. No one'll dare to stop you.
This sapphire blue midriff holster gives easy access to your pistol and ammo, while also functioning as the perfect combat accessory for the "Ophelia Customs" range.
Starpig-designed knife sheath. Keeps your weapon right where you need it, plus the velvet inner on the straps ensures that the smooth lines of your thighs aren't ruined. Now that would be a crime.

Hea Choi is a fan of Teddy Roosevelt's. Zone took his quote of 'Speak softly and carry a big stick' as inspiration and ran with it. Twice. With space for two sidearms this back holster means business.
Specially customized to show off our technological elegance - the Praetorian blue earpiece. Makes the G-Kings look like cavemen.
Zone brings their grunge style to the streets, courtesy of the good guys. The solid holster means your sidearm's easy to draw and even easier to re-holster.
Kaspar Danko was consulted on the design of this lightweight holster. Adjustable to keep your firearm no more than two inches from your hand.
Ultra sharp and ultra discreet. Comes from an undisclosed R&D company owned by one of Justin Teng's contacts in Havalynd.
The knife is the weapon of the true professional – silent and subtle, in a world of cheapass, noisy amateur gangs. Keep it close. Keep it accessible. Keep it stealthy.
An understated double gun shoulder holster with the PT logo. Violet likes these because, from straight on, you can barely tell she's armed at all. The unexpected makes for good tactics.
Round as a gumball and twice as sweet, this earpiece has an attached mic with a patented super-slick surface that won't pick up or smudge makeup.
A leather holster embossed with PT and featuring quick-release snaps. There's a hidden compartment at the bottom for concealing makeup, ammo, sodium pentathol, or whatever.
This PT logo sheath-harness keeps a blade handy for a front cross draw, and it won't get in the way of a long hairstyle. Matching thigh holster available.
This blade is sharp enough to slide through a flak jacket and strong enough not to snap if it grates against armor plating... or ribs.
Nothing but the absolute best will do for a Prentiss Tigress. This mic is sensitive enough to pick up a whisper, the speaker gives near-perfect fidelity, and it's compatible with any cell phone.
A delicate lady's holster by Hard Tackle, in colors so creamy they ought to be swirled on a cone. The matching enamel-handled pistol has extra room in the grip to avoid chipping one's manicure.
Like a silent movie, this shoulder knife sheath rig is black, white, and completely quiet. Ideal for those midnight stealth jobs and revenge raids.
A double gun holster that sits comfortably at the shoulderblades, in the C.S.A. Sting hornet-like colors of black and yellow. Sting 'em hard!
Posture matters, especially when there’s a cute Otome Neko pistol ready to go.

When you're spending four days in a hole waiting for a shot, proper Elbow and Knee protection is important. These elbow-pads have travelled with Devil Dog in some of the worst warzones in the world, and now they're yours.

Growing up, Tiptoe found elbows and knees to be incredibly useful in a scrap. After many mornings waking up with joints that hurt as bad as her hangover, she had these pads crafted to ensure the pain was all one-way.

Even the most professional of Joker Cheerleaders doesn’t get the jump right occasionally. These elbow pads’ll save you when the Pike jump fails.

Fashion evolution in action. This started as a talisman of the Criminals - a 6-sided shuriken that represented the 6 original areas of San Paro. As we reclaim the streets, it's morphing into a 6-sided Sheriff’s badge.

Solid-silver deputy badge. Let everyone know who upholds order around here. Hea Choi recently suggested the addition of a Velcro backing to ensure it always faces the right way - for maximum marketing.
Kicking down doors with so much refinement means  Criminals are bound to know you're a lady of Prentiss. However, if there's any doubt, wear this gold-plated Tigers badge front and center.
These are just an accessory, so don't go round thinking you're wearing back-up ammo.  They're not live rounds, just silver replicas. Only good in a fight if you're beating a werewolf to death.
Warrior pioneered the design of custom made scarf belts. Before they came along the Roses had to use normal neck scarves, which never gave the right tension.
If you really want to know what is in then you don't look to the snobby clubs of Havalynd. You look to kids of Concession  - where punk is back. Get in early or look like a fashion-lagger.
Our bullet belts are being copied by every gang and CSA outfit in San Paro. The bright red casing makes sure your sisters know you are of the same Blood.
Red leather belt with a skull and crossed swords, pirate style. Raiding ports and fighting sea battles is optional though. Sure to be a retro classic in a couple of years' time.
This scarf is just right for letting people know you're an up-and-coming G-King star. Shift used to wear one like it, back when she was just a tagalong tween at the NCSP.
Wanna wear two belts at once? Who the fuck is gonna tell you you can't? This berry one is larger than life and in your face. An example to emulate.
Wearing two belts at once? Who the fuck is gonna tell you you can't? Take that stupid 'Forcer symbol, the Sheriff's star, and put a little G-King rainbow sensibility into it.
Nothing like a fashion statement that acts as a backup ammo supply... Or it would, if these were live rounds. Probably a good thing they're not, or every skate park wipeout would leave you legless.
Simple scarf, with the G Crown logo in blue on dark teal. Tie it around your face for an incognito exit in an emergency - like when a 'Torian hit squad's gunning for you.
A simple little matching belt to go with the Salamander SuitLegs.
Platinum-gold belt. Customized by Jean Ravanelle. Expensive much? You bet your ass it is.
Arlon Benjamin commissioned this simple green belt with skull-and-scimitars buckle for his elite squad to celebrate a hostile takeover. Arrrr!
A Joker branded sweater-belt. Because you’re too cool to actually, you know, wear it like a sweater.
A Bruise Tooth utility belt. Perfect for when you’re in the pit.
Starpig is almost mandatory uniform for Praetorian fems. This woven leather belt will kick off your collection. Try to focus on the 'star' part rather than the 'pig' part and you'll be okay.
Lieutenant Inehower from the SPPD famously ridiculed the Praetorians with the cliché putdown, 'Where's the beef?'. The symbol of the cow's skull was our reply - we ate it and now we are after yours.

This bullet belt was inspired by the recent war photo-journalism exhibition that toured the uptown galleries. An accidental explosion at the manufacturing plant has since made these a limited edition.

On first release this came with live ammo. Some unfortunate incidents involving people standing too near to heat changed all that. However, this dummy ammo version is just as popular. If rather boring...
'If you only have one piece of Vanguard, make it this belt', said Effigy editor Darius Frank. No one knows if he was being ironic or not. But who cares, he still said it, right?
Brown cotton Praetorian hip scarf. Breaks up the skin-tight outfit to give the image of a softer, more approachable Enforcer. Which may, or may not, be the reality.
Brown leather belt with skull buckle. This became an instant fashion statement after the original was shown on N3, helped by the fact Danko used it as an impromptu restraining device during the bust.
Brown double-layered utility belt. This comes from Elite as part of our corporate cross-promotion. We get to select from their new range before anyone else. They get the visibility.
Muted, yet stylish, belt. For when you want to look good - but don't want to be seen.
Military-grade double-ply ballistic nylon utility belt. Shadow Strike-styled and tested. If it works in the jungle it may just about stand up to San Paro.
Droit de Seigneur's belt is a conversation piece. Tough enough to be used to tie a Crim to a chair in a holding cell, stylish enough to be matched with a dress in the evening.
A badass belt by Weekend Warrior, best worn at a slightly jaunty, careless angle around the hips. Show 'em there's a new Sheriff in town.
This belt is a serious piece of hardware. It's said that Stu Phoenix once used one to, er, politely extract information from a suspect who was threatening his niece's schoolteacher.
Breeze blowin' your skirt up? Why not use a strategically placed scarf like this one.  Besides, Ninjette likes this little monkey - angry, agile, and soooo damned cute... Sound familiar?
Crossed, studded belts by Xplore, in ultra-hard-wearing leather with rawhide and gold-stud details. Wrap one around your fist for instant brass knuckles.
Show off a little Prentiss High School pride in this navy-and-gold scarf; sling it around your hips to conceal ammo belts and waist holsters. Just like in high school.
This belt from Trust Fund Guerilla is designed for undercover work. The materials are top-end, and though the skull buckle is a little... urban... it conceals a secret compartment.
What would Joker be without the bullets? This bullet belt really completes the look.
The New Gresty High Top boots are as old school classic as it gets. Not quite the modern skate shoes that you see so often in this town, they’re something that speak of a certain class of Criminal.
Originally colored to look amazing under the neon lights of Club Gaijin, this Jean Zasou-designed leather blazer has crossed over into every part of the city. Deservedly so.

Keep it classy with this black, white and green "Gang Gorilla" blazer from Zoosh. Picked out in Zoosh's popular retro-sketch style, you can wear this jacket when you feel like being formal without it costing you your street cred.
The archetypal G-King item, by Streetgrind: loud, proud and strong. Exclusive too. You are most definitely on your way, baby!
Starpig acquired these hunting vests during a hostile takeover of a competitor; very hostile.
Vanguard's styled leather bomber jacket, as sported by Sabbat. If this is a war zone - then at least let's dress for it.
This bulletproof vest features the crossed sabers version of the Prentiss Tigers crest. Style and substance, practicality and fashion: that's how the Tigers do things.
A Prentiss Tiger, in its more unusual profile view, adorns the back of this hunting vest by Arlington. Mirri Kent has visions of seeing one of these on every high schooler in San Paro.
This bomber jacket is modeled after one worn by Sofia in her upcoming movie 'Gunning For You' - she cut a deal with the studio to allow Tigresses to rock this look now.
Bare your fangs with this hockey mask from Villainy, inspired by a design from one of Lilith Bloodrose's less disturbing sketchbooks.

Byron had a phone wire tap up on Praetorian Saul Linklater for 5 hours. No insider info came through but we did get him screaming, '...and squash those Roses like bugs'. Since then these bug-style Rakshasa glasses went nuclear.
This hockey mask grants the illusion of a walking vampire skull. Good times. But don’t save it just for Halloween: these are great for scaring the opposition all year round.

A 20-minute battle to break into a warehouse and all they had were these Donjon hockey masks. Luckily Charlotte convinced Michael that they only needed a bit of design work to suit them to the Blood Rose style.
Hockey mask, hand painted by Lilith. Rather disturbingly, she calls these works of art 'Mommy's good little girl'.
If you want to be part of Michael Simeone's elite group of CSA Hunters, this Jean Zasou mask will kick you off in the right direction.

Bright on dark, like the screen of the arcade game that inspired this mask's design. Harmon commissioned it for Double-B one day after inadvertently annoying her... That's not a girl you want pissed at you.
Born Dead's hockey mask, one of the most coveted items in the G-King arsenal. You don't get to wear one of these unless you've put the hours in and clocked up a respectable body count. Rock on.
Like warriors throughout history, you're donning a mask to strike fear into the hearts of your enemies. You are as fierce as they come. And now you are rage personified.

This signature mask provides both anonymity and infamy at the same time, perfect for an experienced CSA operative. Devil Dog only gifts these to those that have proven himself to him, which now includes you.

A full-head gas mask with snout filter is a terrifying enough look, but Tiptoe has stepped this one up a notch with her signature style. Only available to members of her brood and those who have thoroughly impressed her.
The famous Bruise Tooth racing team mask. The manic grin probably means something to someone somewhere.
These Defender Armored Armpads are guaranteed to not hinder movement and are based on the Paladin Armor from the Armored Urban Warfare Pack.
Simple and clean, these Defender Armored Shoulderpads leave no one guessing what they’re for. With these on you can shoulder any burden and carry any team.
The Defender Armored Vest Collar was a feature that Templeton insisted by included with the pack. Something about seeing a Criminal take a pool ball to the throat…
The “Defender” Balaclava really shows its strength when working in arctic environments. It really shows its cool when working in urban environments.
The Defender Tactical Elbowpads are simple but effective. They should be your first choice when you need to break a Criminals nose with your elbow.
The Defender Tactical Kneepads have been fine tuned by Templeton to give your knee the support it needs to jump-kick open all the doors in the city.
Probably the most subtle part of the Joker Cheerleader outfit but also the most attention grabbing.
The classic Barnham College schoolgirl skirt is a pretty much as iconic as it gets for school uniform. No ‘San Paro High’ riff-raff here.
Villainy's original "Villainess" design was so successful they set out to create more clothes with it. This new T-shirt is set to bring Villainy back into the limelight.
Hockey masks are back in this year. Until you can get hold of your own real one, here is the next best thing - a Birth brand T-shirt featuring an image.
Stylish, high contrast tank top featuring the work of cutting edge Japanese artist Suki.

Terri Quan of the G-Kings is also a reporter for Channel 211. When asked about Charlotte Bloodrose she said, 'Yeah, she's famous. Maybe dead famous'. A threat or a compliment? Who cares? We turned it into a T-shirt.
Cabra Bara: a label that never goes out of fashion. A staple of the Blood Rose party set. Collect as much as you can - start with this T-shirt.

Villainy had fallen out of favor with the Blood Rose girls earlier in the year. Their female range was seen as a hastily retailored version of the male range. This shirt sends a signal that they are back on form.
A new hoodie from Maison Mercure presenting a virgin bathing in blood to retain her youth. Is this supposed to represent anyone specifically? No one is telling.
Flamingo' started as a showgirl at Gaijin but has just clinched a brand new record deal. Support a fellow Blood Rose by wearing her new T-shirt, made by Cabra Bara.
One of 3N’s cameramen got in the way of Charlotte. When he eventually regained consciousness he described it as being 'punched by an angel'. Donjon got this commemorative design out within 48 hours.
Bring peace, love, harmony and style to San Paro with the Angelgirl Hoodie. Please note: Peace, love and harmony not included.
Crispin Q was overheard pitching a movie about zombie air hostesses. The movie may never get made, but that didn't stop the creation of the 'dipped in blood' style dress.
Eye catching and striking T-shirt from Cabra Bara. This is the super exclusive version where the red dye contains a small amount of Charlotte's blood.
Jean Zasou used a real X-ray of Charlotte, taken when she was hospitalized, to create this striking blouse.
The assignment for the designer of the brand new Forbidden bustier was, 'make it so you wouldn't want to cover it with lesser clothing'. Job done.
Tank top kicked down by your neighbor.
Ringer T given out during C.S.A. training.
Plain and simple cotton T-Shirt.
Veronika loves the new "Gang Gorilla" design from Zoosh, so she got them to make this tank top for her.  If the cute, dumb look on the Gorilla's face reminds her of Zombie, she ain't telling...
Feels like they've been putting APBs out on the G-Kings since the days of 8-bit. Show you know it's all a game with this T-Shirt.
Birth designed this shirt for a little niece of his, when she asked for a pony. Once the hysterics ended, he re-issued the design for adults.
New Cross Skate Park's logo, a gorilla in a trucker hat, and an eye-watering red and green combo: this shirt is worthy of Veronika Lee for sheer fashion brass ballsiness.
Underwear by GutterStar. Shift thinks they're pretty sweet. Seems a shame to cover them up; she hopes you won't.
Non-Gs often don't quite 'get' Birth's sense of humor. After a recent catwalk, a fashion critic said he'd gone 'utterly cuckoo'... This was Birth's response, couriered to her office.
Chiro, on request, inked this bizarre design on a client; Birth was so taken with it that he made it into a T-shirt.
Retro gear, tailored by Javez for the G-Kings. Goes with just about everything and everyone.  And so does this shirt.
Shift's name's all over this hoodie - Harmon's boosting our visibility through her reputation, and with style this sharp, everyone wins out.
A Zoosh Skatewear ringer T in hot fuschia. Notable because when they released this design, it was the first unveiling of their new logo - now, of course, an old-school classic.
A Zoosh special. Somehow Grayson always manages to get the really hot stuff before anyone else does. Not bad for an objectionable, mean-tempered geek.
Unapologetically branded with not only the G-crown logo but also the lizard and skateboard wheel that have come to represent us. You'll be a reigning G-Queen in no time with this.
The piece de resistance: a beast of a custom turtleneck. Combine with the matching outlaw mask from this outfit to create something fuckin' memorable.
New Gresty is everything about Gresty distilled into one outfit. You can’t have Gresty without a skateboard and this one’s fresh from the ramps of New Cross.
Nothing says hardcore like carrying a 20lbs satellite radio your back. The perfect accompaniment to any die-hard mercenary.
Retro Joker branding. You liked Joker before it was cool.
A Joker branded turtle neck. It looks great on the arms, but it’ll look even better on the dance floor.
Branding for the Bruise Tooth racing team and their sponsors. Show your allegiance!

""Ophelia Customs" T by Elite. Featuring a 'tasteful' representation of the lady herself, this T is both water and grease resistant so you won't make a mess of it when you're in the garage, or anywhere else that's... extra icky."

The Praetorians get a lot of new recruits because of their sponsorship of the local football team, the Stallions. Part of the deal is that we get to wear the official merchandise, as worn by star players Chimola and Bosker.
Go undercover with this new shirt from Player, inspired by Criminal symbology. In truth, the heart represents the city of San Paro and the dagger, the continuing wounds the gangs inflict.

Film director Crispin Q is trying to persuade Praetorian CEO Justin Teng to invest in his new film. As a sweetener he has given us all promo T-shirts from his last lame-ass zombie flick, 'The Afflicted'.
You probably saw the Deity ads when you were a kid; they kinda disappeared in the '90s and everything went all techno-techno. Screw techno, we're bringing back rock, the old school way.
The new hoodie from Ruined features the famous San Paro Jade Griffin. It was repeatedly hidden, fought over and sold during the 16th Century. Some things never change.
The Praetorian brand is everything. Only those that have proved themselves are allowed to wear our slogan: 'Backup is here'. Printed by Vanguard, worshipped by wannabes, earned by you.
This Vanguard bulletproof vest comes with the warning 'Does not stop fast-moving projectiles'. So, no tactical advantage there, then. The only thing it will protect you against is looking boring.
Vanguard long-sleeved shirt. These are supposed to be only worn by Praetorian admin staff. But why should Janice in Accounting hog all the swag?

Exclusive 'The Death Jacks' t-shirt - a band famous for dressing the drummer as Acid Jack and shooting him at the end of a gig. The value of this item rocketed recently due to the drummer returning fire.

Cervantes said, 'Delay always breeds danger; and to protract a great design is often to ruin it.' The designer spent so long on his long sleeved shirt it went out of fashion. So he did this one instead and became an instant hit.
Triple-layered 'Shadow-strike' style full torso coverage. Dark as hell - they will not see you coming.
Templeton oversaw the design of this Armored Vest with a little help from Wilde Designs. Wilde insisted on the high-vis lining and Templeton insisted on the name over the shoulders.
The Defender Radio Backpack doesn’t work as a radio and is mostly there to look cool. The number of cell phone signals in the city makes most radio communications impossible.
This sleek and sexy black halter dress lets you say a 'sweet FU' in style.

FU's sporting bulletproof vests are worn by San Paro's top athletes as precaution against gunfire from the crowd. Maximizing freedom of movement without sacrificing protection, they also work extremely well for chasing down Crims!
Whether they choose to show it or not, every Prentiss Tiger has a team number. Violet's is 13 - what else could you give a girl who was dragged from the river riddled with bullet holes...?
Prentiss' own Boxing Club and Gym is seriously exclusive and accepts nothing but the best. Just like the Tigers.
Vintage styled hoodie by Prentiss All Star. Wouldn't try to flip the hood up for anonymity - not with their logo all over this stylin' piece of sportswear.
Droit de Seigneur's astonishing 'Nouvelle Chinoise' dress, designed with Mirri Kent in mind and sported by her in her Effigy photo shoot. Clean lines and classic styling; that's what she's about.

A long-sleeved shirt from Prentiss All Star; part of their 'Prentiss Vintage' line. Takes you back to when kids could play in the street without needing the latest back-to-school stab vest from Childminder (TM).
Ninjette loves Akiko's style and make no secret of that fact. They imitated her shirt - with her permission, of course; none of them wanted to wake up minus a finger or two.
An official Prentiss Tigers bulletproof vest. The cut was approved by Akiko X so as not to interfere with dexterity and movement. Stay vested, stay safe.
This backless halter dress by Droit de Seigneur is a complete stunner. The bold print takes off an ad for one of Sofia's debut albums, back during a short-lived punk secreterial phase. Don't ask…
A cap-sleeve pink ringer T by Ninjette. We like to think the cute little cat-hatted girl is also trained to use her jump rope as a garrotte.  Because we have issues.
Classic Arlington styling with a new twist. Violet Prentiss has been seen in this top when the Tigresses go on the prowl, though hopefully she wasn't spotted by the Blood Roses…
For increased comfort: keep the girls locked down and the Crims locked up.
The original 'Team Tiger' turtleneck minidress. Chiza, back in her lacrosse-playing days, modified hers so many times that her coach just gave up and let her wear it however she liked.
You participated in the APB beta and all you got were multiple gunshot wounds - and this lousy long-sleeved shirt. Oh yeah - and Realtime Worlds' thanks.
The "Asylum Pryde" hoodie not only helps shield your face from CCTV cameras, but lets everyone know you're down with the Crim gatherings at Abington Towers once a month.
This ringer T in don't-touch-me hornet colors is emblazoned with the distinctive "Fist Pump" logo. You're now a C.S.A.-licensed Enforcer: give those Crims a sting they'll never get over.
A Joker branded crop top. No matter what angle people see you from they’ll know who supplied the bullets that just ruined their ride.
Angelic hunk, Johnny Valance recently wore this Wildcats top in a top-rated 'sode of '20-second Jump'. Coincidentally, this vest is immensely popular amongst the Barnham College fems right now.
The Barnham Blouse is the mark for a girl that’s been through one of the finest finishing schools in the city. How the hell did you get one of these tops?
Complete the Barnham look with this crop top.
They say if you've got it, you should flaunt it. Villainy obviously agrees because these snakeskin-styled leggings go all-out to highlight your curves.
What with coming from Tokyo and being a bit of a style guru,  Suji has  introduced us to a lot of what's hot in the Shibuya club scene. Not all of it gels with the Rose vibe. But these definitely do.
A Blood Rose classic. These are the style of combats first worn by Charlotte in the early days of the Roses. Now worn as a good luck charm as well as ensuring you look ‘Rosesome’.
If you want to proclaim your Blood Rose allegiance then this Eliza Bathory skirt is for you. A big white thorn on a blood red background makes it clear who you work for.
These jeans are unusual, but Byron loves them. To be honest, with that Cabra Bara logo on the back, you could be wearing a cow costume and you'd still get respect.

We got word that Terri Quan from the G-Kings was getting self-conscious about her thighs getting fat. So Maison Mercure designed these extra tight skinny jeans for us. There is more than one way to beat the opposition.
Super-tight shorts from Maison Mercure. Shrink fit. Wear them in the bath. Not just to make them fit better, but for fun too.

Villainy maxed out the lace on this tutu. Then they had to backtrack and remove several layers because it kept getting caught on the gun holsters. This is the final result - feminine, yet safe to wear with a pistol.
Famous ballerina Anna Pavlova said that the tutu, 'gave immense grace, freedom of movement and ensured everyone's eyes were on you'. As true today as it was then.
Birth skirt. Currently in demand due to being worn by a crazy Midtown girl on the Mikko Wong show. Crazy because she actually gave birth whilst wearing it. Live. On air.
Short skirts are fun for a while but sometimes you just have to get down to some serious, violent, dangerous business. Another future classic from Jean Zasou.
Warm-up pants kicked down by your neighbor.
Warm-up pants given out during C.S.A. training.
Plain and simple five-pocket denim jeans with contrast stitching.
A stylish pair of wide-legged suit trousers from Zoosh, designed to go with the "Gang Gorilla" blazer but striking enough to stand out on their own.
The design on these warm-up pants is based on one of Javez's early tag stencils.
A recent fad at Chiro's Tattoo Parlour has been to get a tattoo of this top-of-the-sneaker shot on the lower back, and then add corset piercings for the laces.
Cargo shorts by Born Dead - in a city this dangerous, you might as well've been.

GutterStar's darling little mascot has made it out of the focus groups with flying colors. Projected tie-ins include a plushie doll, a Saturday morning cartoon, and a "Chibi GUTRsta" line of tween lingerie.
Another Boardhawk special. Bright and aggressive. Just the thing when you're out making your mark on San Paro.
The New Cross Skate Park's logo blazes out from this skirt like a beacon in the dark, and you aren't afraid of a little attention. Go get 'em girl!
Lizard King knockoff cargo shorts, hot off the presses. For those urban jungle safaris.
Bonita Benjamin was kind enough to permit her signature wide-legged suit trousers to be referenced in this amazing lizard-printed version, in hot pink.
One of GUTRsta's embroidery wet dreams. Imported silk thread. Rugged canvas. Reinforced seams. Sheer badassery.
Joker branded denim shorts. Hey, if everyone’s gonna be lookin’ at your butt all the time you might as well have an advert there.
Pit crew pants for the Bruise Tooth racing team. Racing season might be canceled but the spirit lives on.

Flame retardant, grease resistant, full-length combat pants - a redesign of the type worn by Ophelia around her customs workshop. If these pants can survive a full APC engine overhaul and re-grease, they can survive just about anything.
Inside Out designed these shorts to be reversible in 'an emergency'. However the design on the inside became more popular than the one the outside, giving them the 'Outside In' nickname.
The Conflikt Clothing Company is well respected in military life for the resilience of the materials they use. So these entry level combats are still tougher than anything available to civilians.
Zone received a 13% lift in sales last month when Ty Durrant was featured on 2iP TV arresting an arsonist. The fact that his Zone combats were actually on fire at the time ensured multiple reruns.
These shorts are Praetorian-only. If you ain't part of the squad you'll get slapped in cuffs for just wearing 'em. We don't give this shit out to just anyone, you know.

Fed up with a choice of black combats or green combats? There was almost a strike last year amongst the female Praetorians so they could get something more exciting. These jeans arrived the next day, direct from LaRocha.
The classic Vanguard combats have been exclusively redesigned for the female Praetorians, at last! The word is, the guys at Vanguard didn't want to do it, but Justin Teng was owed a few favors.
Live the full-on Grissom experience. Vanguard took apart his combat pants from Laos, added some style and created these. Hopefully they asked first…
If you're walking your patch then at least show off your legs; thanks to Conflikt you can let your legs do the talking. As recommeded by  Eva Orlandez.
Starpig says, 'loose clothing is for people whose figures we can't do much with'. These camo effect leggings are not for those kind of people.

Triple-layered, micro-woven full length combat pants. Female redesign of the type worn by Danko for over a year during prolonged African urban skirmishes and only available to the Special Forces team.
Violet likes to show her legs off at every opportunity; perhaps that's why she had these leggings made. She does everything with a degree of bitchiness that could only come from an ex-Blood Rose.
FU's gold bar design capris. A recent trend on the Barnham College campus; now hot with the Tiger first response teams. Ensure you're always prepared to chase down a Crim.
From All Star's Prentiss Vintage line, these relaxed-fit warm-ups feature 'go-faster' stripes. Go faster, dig deeper, play harder, then party hearty.
In a recent interview, Sofia said the Tigers were a sun radiating a new dawn across San Paro. That's the theme of these Apollo Rising combats. Plus, now the sun can shine out your ass.
Prentiss All Star gave this flounced skirt sporty styling without making it cheerleader-length. Its swing and movement allows for two hidden pockets, too.
Hard Tackle designed these for the Prentiss' cheerleading squad. We added hidden reinforcements at ass and knee, for a harder-wearing version.
Prentiss All Star carpenter pants, to complete an aviator look. Byeong Lee is a particular fan of these, as they're practical as well as designer.
From Arlington's "Greek Week" collection, the signature lace under this tutu is pierced to resemble leopard-print. If you end up doing a kegstand, your wild side will show.
The legendary cut of these micro-weave pants makes them great for warming up on the basketball court, prison yard, or gun range. Anywhere you need to run, block, or shoot, really.

The Forbidden range of lingerie was designed with the Blood Roses in mind. Byron has all the modeling shots that Charlotte did for them way back. Do not let your boyfriend get hold of those under any circumstances.

Was it forgetfulness, daring or a bit of both that made Lilith dress in just this thong last week? Either way - wear them while they're hot.
Keep the Roses close to your heart. Whatever else you wear - you'll know you're a Blood Rose where it matters.

The New Gresty Bikini Bottoms have Birth’s name on them mostly so he can say he’s been in the pants of every woman in the city. Because he’s a classy guy like that.
The New Gresty Bikini Top is perfect for those long days at the beach, sunny days at the park or drive by shootings in Baylan. Comfort and style, folks.
Vanguard bikini bottoms. Seen only when they have to be. But you'll know they're always there. Just like the Praetorians.
Vanguard bikini top. Protecting your assets. Supporting your reputation.

It's a jungle out there, but it probably shouldn't be a jungle 'down there' - not if you're rocking the official Praetorian camo thong. The only item we provide that actually goes up in value when it’s second-hand.
A new strapless version of the classic camo bra. Brought in after complaints from Jennifer Kim that the straps on the standard issue bra interfered with her shoulder holster.
These stockings are nothing short of fabulous. Mirri wore a similar pair with a very short dress to an ad agency meeting, and wouldn't you know it... she got every concession she requested.

This adhesive bra "looks good enough to eat". At least that's what it said on the packaging…
Droit de Seigneur's almost Art Deco take on the string bikini bottom. So retro it's ahead of its time.
An elegent, charcoal-and-roses sheen makes your legs look endless. It's basic tactics: the longer your legs look, the faster people think you can run.

Barely-there thong that won't cut into your hips or show through and ruin the line of your jeans. It's said that once, when completely out of ammo, Chiza slipped hers off and used it as a garrotte.
Excellent underwire support that won't cut into your ribs or ruin a T-shirt's line. May accidentally pick up Radio Luxembourg on a clear day…
Bare your fangs, not your bosoms, in this bra emblazoned with a snarling tiger. Now back in classic navy and cream.
Bare your fangs, not your booty, in these boyshorts emblazoned with a snarling tiger. Now back in classic navy and cream.

A good tactical vest is important for carrying kit on the field, but that doesn't mean it can't be a great fashion accessory. Hard Tackle have designed a personalised vest for Devil Dog, and he's deemed you enough of a badass to do it proud.
A rifleman's pouch set for Devil Dog's tactical vest.
The Defender Rifleman Config has all the bells, whistles, bullets and bombs you’ve come to expect from Shadow Strike in a cool Wilde Designs package.
This "Wildcard" Shoulder Holster from Villainy features a smooth drawing action and speed-loader carriers allowing you to deal bullets faster than a casino deals cards.
The official Blood Rose tie. And just like your old school tie, it should be worn half undone.
Ultra-modern high-tech earpiece. Byron discovered a small shipment heading for the posers high up in the Needles. Somehow, they never quite made it there.
Keep a Blood Rose thorn by your side. Designed to be visible (and definitely not concealed), this knife sheath is all about intimidation.
Seung's link to a more innocent past. Stolen as a teenager from a long-repossessed fashion store on Empire Boulevard, this predates the genesis of the Blood Roses.
The Blood Rose desert scarf. As Seung says: 'Without it, you're just some trendy kid on the make. With it, you look like a Blood Rose'.
Infamy knife sheath. Discreet and subtle from afar, yet eye-catching up close. Just because you want to have a concealed weapon it doesn't mean your style needs to be hidden.
Official Blood Rose knife shoulder holster. Suji used inspiration from the niche ninja-inspired gangs of Tokyo to come up with something totally Blood Rose.
This Jean Zasou-designed holster has already been commandeered by the Praetorians. But somehow it just looks so much damn cooler on us.
Zoosh retro gear. This one's top of the line. Has a handy pack you can keep your smokes in, and a nice big blade for cutting 'Forcers down to size. Dare them to try and confiscate it.
This earpiece was designed with the racers from "The Hazard"  in mind. The mic damps background noise, especially engine and wind.
X-Pygg styling at its finest - this thigh holster belonged to an SPPD officer once upon a time. Now it's way more trendy. And it's yours. Improvements all round.

Since Streetgrind brought these things into style, G-Kings have been terrorizing the Financial district like something out of an alien invasion. Anonymity and cool-factor combined; what's not to like?
If you get caught wearing this holster, you're definitely gonna end up in a cross-hair. But, hey, when's that ever stopped you? With notoriety as high as yours, the cross-hair is your happy place.
This cutting-edge little gizmo tunes automatically in to Radio Free G at the touch of a button; get the latest heads-up when an Asylum night is happening, and stay in touch with Arlon.
The Praetorians avoid a strict uniform. But items such as this armband help to ensure that you get the proper respect out there and don't get mistaken for a lone, amateur, vigilante loser.
Vanguard knife sheath. Miguel Estebano's favorite weapon now has its very own custom-made thigh holder. Tap into a slice of Miguel's fearful reputation.
Another great 'Praetorian Riotwear' must-have: the padded upper arm band. If you barge through a door wearing anything else, you'll feel underdressed.
A first class comm unit. Someone looks at you now, they know they are looking at the whole Praetorian squad that backs you up.
Keep it old skool with this aged-effect leather knife shoulder holster from the legendary Starpig.
Some designs are just classic - though that doesn't mean they can't be improved. Zone have reinvigorated the 70's cop holster with stylish new details.
Specially customized to demonstrate our technological prowess and resources - the Praetorian blue earpiece with yellow strap and LEDs.
After the CSA was passed, every chump and his monkey wanted to offer protection. Make sure Criminals know exactly who they are dealing with. Wear the 'Special Forces' armband.
The Conflikt Clothing Company loved the Shadow Strike look so much they wanted in. The result: the official San Paro Special Forces desert scarf.
Kaspar Danko designed this double-secured, triple-supported holster. Adjustable to keep your firearm no more than two inches from your hand.
Ultra sharp and ultra discreet. Comes from an undisclosed R&D company owned by one of Justin Teng's contacts in Havalynd.
The Prentiss Tigers logo is painstakingly embroidered in fade-proof silk thread on this reinforced shoulder holster. Matches the PT Leather Boots beautifully.
Prentiss Tigers rock! This armband can be combined with absolutely anything to leave everyone around you crystal clear as to whose side you're on.
From Hard Tackle's Fox Off collection: angry fox is angry. And will fuck your shit up.
A heavy-duty holster by Weekend Warrior. Sometimes they still get things right, even if most of their apparel is completely passé.
From Trust Fund Guerrilla's BluSteel line of weaponry accessories. Stu Phoenix had a hand in its creation after an all night brew session with the head of TFG's design department.

If Simon Tran hadn't had this model during a raid the Tigers pulled last week, he might not be with us now. Thankfully, this comm unit survived immersion in the Nantego and a knife stab from a three foot assassin…
Armband by Hard Tackle. When Chiza got grazed by a bullet, Chung-hee ripped one of these right off his own arm and used it to staunch the blood flow.
This scarf is modeled on the one Orlenz' used on the Prentiss Tiger's very first foray out. That night, he learned the value of a dark scarf pulled up to cover his face.
A high-tech mic and earpiece by Full Contakt. Byeong Lee wants you reachable at all times - never know when shit's gonna get real and all the Tigers will need to converge on a problem.
Everything looks better with a PT logo. Orlenz' swears by this blade - it's sharp. Very, very sharp.
Like a silent movie, this shoulder knife sheath rig is black, white, and completely quiet. Ideal for those midnight stealth jobs and revenge raids.
A gun rig that sits comfortably at rib level for a quick draw and easy concealed carry, in the C.S.A. Sting hornet-like colors of black and yellow. Sting 'em hard!
Ice blue and snow white. A fresh style for a fresh new look from Ninjette.
Complete the Ninjette FM look with this stylish, functional thighpad.
Complete the Ninjette FM look with this stylish, functional thighpad.
This tie puts the management in Anger Management.

When you're spending four days in a hole waiting for a shot, proper Elbow and Knee protection is important. These elbow-pads have travelled with Devil Dog in some of the worst warzones in the world, and now they're yours.

When you're spending four days in a hole waiting for a shot, proper Elbow and Knee protection is important. These knee-pads have travelled with Devil Dog in some of the worst warzones in the world, and now they're yours.

Growing up, Tiptoe found elbows and knees to be incredibly useful in a scrap. After many mornings waking up with joints that hurt as bad as her hangover, she had these pads crafted to ensure the pain was all one-way.

A Joker branded Elbow Pads. All the security of elbow-pads with all the cache of the Joker brand.
A Joker branded Knee Pads. Who’s laughing now? No one. That’s who.
A Deputy's badge forged from reclaimed white gold contraband. The original symbol of justice - reworked for today.
Darryl Kent sports this sheriff's badge under his suit jacket in the Praetorian boardrooms. It never hurts to remember whose side you're really on.
Only in San Paro would a new fashion line need a tactical belt.
A wide, studded belt fashioned from dark, blood-red leather. Some Blood Rose guys take out a stud for every 'Forcer they take down. It's a handy way to keep count.
This low ride belt became very popular with the Blood Rose guys in Havalynd. So much so that it got the nickname 'Low Rose'.

The most exclusive bullet belt in San Paro. No one even knows who makes it. The ads in Effigy had a simple photo. Below was a quote from Brecht - 'Do not fear death so much, but rather the inadequate life.'
Limited edition Cabra Bara belt. Nicknamed the 'Bible belt', as it seems to offer almost god-like support.
The current trend within the SPPD is to call us outlaws. Wearing crossed belts sends a message back that says 'yeah... and?'
Platinum limited edition of the Infamy belt. This was the first item Infamy made available to the Blood Roses - and it's still one of the most sought-after.
Belt, by Birth. Holds your jeans up. The end.
Born Dead's logo on an acid green belt, commissioned by Terri Quan to match her special-order shorts. She gave these out as a thank-you gift to the Gs who showed her around.
This belt looks slammin' with low-rider shorts.
Leather that's red as blood and thick as a clot, with studs as mean and sharp as you are. If you have a lady-friend to hug, give her fair warning... Stud.
A low-slung leather belt, fashionably weathered. Expensive and reliable. Just like Grayson Fell - who can also be low-down and dirty, when he feels like it...
Add this hip belt to your getup and never be without a last-ditch weapon: this thing is heavy, but portable, and will decisively end any bar brawl.
A worn-effect, low-slung, leather belt, complete with platinum trimmings. Rock it with baggy jeans or low-riding shorts.

The "Ophelia Customs" utility belt from Elite is at home in the garage or on the streets. Featuring plenty of pockets and pouches, it'll allow handy access to all your bolts, bullets and a spare distributor cap wherever you go.
Starpig are a good client. Check out this belt they made for the guys. Yeah, ok, we're the pigs, whatever - but it's the Criminals that made this place into a shithole.
On first release this came with live ammo. Some unfortunate incidents involving people standing too near to heat changed all that. This dummy ammo version is just as popular. If rather boring...
Estebano is a giant 'Iron Cannon' fan. Get on his good side by wearing this belt.
Brown leather belt with skull buckle. This became an instant fashion statement after the original was shown on N3; helped by the fact Danko used it as an impromptu restraining device during the bust.
Brown utility belt by Elite. The visual impact comes from the stark yellow attachments, but not everyone can pull it off.
Military grade double-ply ballistic nylon utility belt. Shadow Strike styled and tested. If it works in the jungle, it may just about stand up to San Paro.

Good old Mr. Kent wore his belts this way so they’d fit under his ever-growing belly. Luckily, his castoffs are now the perfect shape for low-ride cuts. Just stay off TV news for a while, or Darryl will be busted for taking them...
This belt's leather is supple as well as strong, and won't flake or crack as you kick down doors or jump fences. Pay more, get quality.
A few years ago there was a fad for Wild West styling; this belt brings back some of that Rodeo Retro. By Trust Fund Guerrilla. Ride 'em, cowboy.
Woven leather belt; just the sort of thing Orlenz's father would have in mind. Don't let that stop you - no reason you can't make it your own.
Belts so heavy they're practically bomb proof. Especially useful when you need one for an emegency fan belt repair, because the other'll still keep your pants up.
Xplore has been very pun-heavy in naming its couture recently, but something must be working for them: this belt was spotted on a Phaze cover model.
This belt keeps spare ammo, gold credit card, or other odds and ends close to hand. Chung-hee swears by his, having added a grappling kit.
A Joker branded Low Rider Studded Belt. Black leather and titanium studs come together here to form the last word in style and baggy pants retention.
The New Gresty High Top boots are as old school classic as it gets. Not quite the modern skate shoes that you see so often in this town, they’re something that speak of a certain class of Criminal.
A Joker branded Hightop Shoes. Simple, understated and restrained. Nice and relaxed.
Michael Simeone accused Cabra Bara of creating such a wide range of clothing that it was producing 'visual anarchy' within the Blood Roses. This best-selling jacket is their retort.
Infamy created this new jacket as part of their 'The Infamous' sub-brand. The binary code on the back contains Praetorian LaRocha's phone number. Just for fun.
The best way to describe this jacket is that it's an 'official bootleg' of the one worn by Jeung. But cooler. And newer.
Originally colored to look amazing under the neon lights of Club Gaijin, this Jean Zasou-designed leather blazer has crossed over into every part of the city. Deservedly so.

The ultimate smash-n-grabber's jacket, complete with the latest Javez GK design. Stops glass, short blades, and, most importantly, rain. Dunno about shrapnel though. Can't find anyone ballsy enough to check.
It's a poorly-kept secret that the drift racing team "The Hazard" is bankrolled by Grayson Fell; their sponsors and logo are splashed over this weather-proofed biker jacket.
In a recent contest among students, Barnham College's crest was re-imagined to reflect 'the San Paro of today'. The administration wasn't thrilled with the result, but the ayes had it.
Being recognized while pulling a job can be kind of cool, but it'll come back to bite you later. Keep yourself looking stylish, but avoid the repercussions with this new hockey mask from Villainy.
Seung went through a phase of wearing bright blue contact lenses. Jeung saw this as an insult to their heritage and banned them. Seung's solution was these completely opaque goggles.
A 20-minute battle to break into a warehouse and all they had were these Donjon hockey masks. Score! Luckily they only needed a bit of design work to suit them to the Blood Rose style.
Jeung met Jean Zasou at The Gaijin Club last month. The normally reticent and aloof Jean was excited to get into the Blood Rose market, but on one condition - to provide items only for the elite.
Experimental polarizing surface-coated goggles. Total visibility for you. Completely black to them. Won't glint or glare. Perfect for a member of Simeone's elite.
A skull wearing a do-rag in G-King colors... Nothin' on earth like it guaranteed to bring a warm, wet feeling to the front of a 'Forcer's pants.

You're getting into a lot of heavy shit these days, and that can create fine lines and the first signs of aging. Protect your eyes with these - the better to keep the blood an' brain matter outta them.
Gotta love "The Hazard's" in-your-face graffiti styled logo; it lends this face mask a certain glow-in-the-dark ballsiness. Want the matching cap? Check out the Hazard Lid.
Grayson Fell allowed copies to be made of his signature sport sunglasses. These things are not only cool as hell, but curve around your head perfectly.
Apparently these sunglasses are unbreakeable: the glass is supposed to be bulletproof, but I wouldn't go getting any dumb ideas.
First thing you learn as a 'Forcer - don't let people see what you're thinking. Plus these shades are in such high demand we have to protect every delivery of them going into Heston Mall.
See and be seen. Gold frame, designer lenses.  All that Criminals will see will be their own worthless reflections leering back at them.
Hot off the factory line and looking fine. These 'Watching You' shades mean that all eyes are on your eyes, while your eyes may be elsewhere. Or not…
Shadow Strike Attack Force mask. Simple design. Built from revolutionary micro-engineered fabric that actually draws in oxygen. We shouldn't have these, but we do.
Resistant to debris, foreign objects, small projectiles, tear gas and chemical sprays. In fact generally resistant to Criminal behavior. So your kind of thing.

Chung-Hee once tried his hand at being a masked hero - descending from the rooftops to pounce on Blood Roses as the "Laughing Tiger". He's long lost interest in his alter ego, but Prentiss Tigers still have fun scaring Crims with these masks.
The coolest looking goggles we've ever seen. That's why Mirri Kent acquired them from a kindly sponsor. But don't actually try to use them; they were made to view the recent eclipse.
These goggles' reflective black surfaces allow the ultimate poker face; no one can see your eyes, which means no one can see where you're aiming.
Hard Tackle had San Paro's skyline as well as their logo printed one-way on these shades. See the city through the city and remember what you're here to protect.
Tiger-striped sports sunglasses. Back in the early days, Tiger-cub wannabes from Fortuna Village and other neighborhoods near Prentiss would wear these to demonstrate their allegiance.
Cooler than ice - Orlenz' rarely covers up his lady-killin' hazel peepers, but when he does, these are the aviators he chooses.
Now that you're one of Byeong Lee's hunters, make life a little harder for Criminal hit squads looking for you. This hockey mask is striped to match your outfit.
Asylum's distinctive font was manipulated by an up-and-coming DJ's kid sister to create this skull-jaw effect. This exclusive run of masks with her design was silkscreened onto black Egyptian cotton.
A pair of these aviators gives you that protected feeling of impersonal distance from the perp you're collaring like nothing else on the market.

Blood Rose head honcho Michael Simeone always says we need to retain a certain style. I'm not sure if these spats-inspired sneakers were what Michael had in mind, but that hasn’t stopped them being incredibly popular.
Jumping fences. Kicking down doors. Climbing over rooftops. It's terrain anarchy out there in San Paro. So wear suitable footwear at all times. Like these.
Debut shoes from a fresh, new designer who grew up with Lilith Bloodrose. Called 'Rad', their whole range features radiation themes. So their forthcoming Fallout Pants are not what you think.
These walking boots are soft-soled enough to suit an assassin. An extremely fashionable assassin.
The big name designers out there are creating some very fancy sneakers and shoes. But sometimes you just need solid mass with which to kick a door in.

Bryon designed these shoes using the latest composite materials. Adopted by many of the Blood Roses, they quickly picked up the name 'Red Shift' - how you measure fast-moving stellar objects. Like us.
The heel of these 'Birth' sneakers contains a C-shaped piece of high-pressure gel. This allows for comfort and performance, as well as a cool name: the 'C-Section'.
Rated 'Best Boot' in F'n'G magazine for what they dubbed "run-by shootings".

An artisan up in Midtown adds the print to these boots especially to order. Okay, so he probably shouldn't, because it's a total ripoff of the Infamy design. But we're all guilty of something a little like that, aren't we?
Two-tone red and black brogues. Not pictured is the exclusive Blood Rose double-sided shoe brush set.
Plain and simple white sneakers with shiny silver faux-leather details.
Tactical boots by Birth, one of San Paro's most popular anti-establishment designers. They can take whatever you throw at 'em - just like you.
The distinctive acid-green board wheels were first sported by Chiro back in the day - now they're on these NCSP skate shoes.
New Cross Skate Park's tag logo across the back of these shoes means no-one'll be able to mistake you for anything other than G-affiliated. Gresty forever, baby.
Skate shoes by Streetgrind, design by Birth. Good grip, whether skating on asphalt or on an Enforcer's face...
New Cross Skate Park's tag logo and bold splashes of red - Zombie had them add those, so that blood spatter would be less noticeable.
Fact: GKs are the most comfy shoes for kicking open a bank back door. You're definitely runnin' with the G-Kings now...
The graffiti in New Cross Skate Park is like family portraits to the G-Kings. Our best and brightest came up with the NCS logo, and we added it to these exclusive skate shoes. Skate on, boyee.
Boardhawk swag is red-hot with the G-Kings lately. These skate shoes were part of a 500-pair limited run, one of which can now be on your feet. Lucky you.
The star on these skate shoes is part of "The Hazard's" in-your-face graffiti styled logo. Gotta love it... Grayson Fell sure does.
A pair of full-grain leather, rubber-soled, top quality urban shit-kicker boots.

The stores are currently full of brightly colored sneakers which are fun, but useless for serious Enforcers like you. These matte black sneakers have been specifically designed to reduce extraneous reflections.
A lot of the kids who sign up with the Praetorians have got the gusto but they ain't got the gear. This is a seriously tough job and these are the seriously tough boots to do it in.
Ever been stuck in San Paro without a vehicle and had to desperately run to get somewhere? Ty Durrant has; so he canvassed Starpig to craft these, the best street boots ever.
You'll be patrolling more than ever now. May as well be comfortable doing it, right? These good ol' sneakers'll keep your feet from aching.
Grissom is ex-military. His first requisition upon joining the Praetorians was these boots. "You can't chase down lawless thugs while you’re worrying about tripping over your own goddamn laces".
It is rumored that Javez says his greatest single weapon is his sneakers - he can run faster than anyone trying to catch him. Until now? Give him a run for his money.
Starpig spent six months in R&D to develop this new boot. It has the perfect balance between strength and weight for kicking in doors.

Brown leather, corrosion-proof sole, steel-toed. Built for wading through the toxic wasteland that is San Paro - and kicking stuff! Our logo is on the back - so the guy you leave in the gutter will know who you work for.
Assault Kinetic are trialing their new black leather and steel toecap boots with us. So give them a good workout.
Tough military style boots. For people who want to gain their reputation by their actions rather than flashy design.
The most comfortable sneakers money can buy. You can bet your trust fund that not one of their materials is inferior.
The Tigers love the FU brand right now. Their designs are all satires on prep clothing, hence the big FU letters. FU, you dig? Like fuck you. Hilarious.
The All-Star brand adores Sofia and she is on a crusade to guarantee we aren’t seen as dull next to the brash and colorful gangs. These sneakers launched the campaign – want to be her ‘running mate’?
The official Prentiss Tigers shoes. Mirri Kent had these made as the first step in creating a whole new PT range. Better than the Tiger's thong she had designed.
The Prentiss Tigers logo is painstakingly embroidered in fade-proof silk thread, and with the grip their soles have on the asphalt, these will be your go-to boots for foot chases.
Get back to the future with these retro styled vintage Prentiss Tigers socks for jocks.
Get back to the future with these retro styled vintage Prentiss Tigers socks for jocks.
Akiko wanted to bring a bit of color to the lives of us 'monochrome kitties'. Wear them, make her happy, and then we can get some peace and quiet.
Brogues don't come much sharper than this. Boardroom chic at its best, but their soles are thick, non-slip rubber. Go straight from budget meeting to firefight in Droit de Seigneur style.
These boots got their name when Mirri Kent, on first seeing them, stated that the gold grommets looked like two rows of fangs. Weird, but it kind of stuck…
These steel toes will crack a cheekbone right down the middle - Chung-hee recently stopped a mugging in its tracks when he ruined a gang-banger's face with these bad boys.
Skate shoes with excellent traction. Specially commissioned by Stu Phoenix, who was tired of seeing his team choose fashion over function - he made sure these had both.
Black, ice blue and white sneakers. Comfortable, stylish and perfectly fitted.
Based on the Impact Urban Warfare Pack’s forearmpads these New Gresty variants are not only eye catching but they’re supported to help prevent RSI brought on by recoil.
Based on the Impact Urban Warfare Pack’s shinpads these New Gresty variants feature two-tone knee pads and an awesome tag at the bottom of them based on one of Birth’s first hits.
These thighpads were designed by Birth from the Impact Urban Warfare defaults. They’re designed to allow full freedom of movement while keeping you locked and ready for anything.
They say when Lilith saw these she squealed 'pure white on the outside, blood red on the inside, just like me!' Since that moment, these became available only to her favorites.

G-Kings collect Praetorian gloves as if they were scalps. Then they customize 'em. How's that for recycling? Arlon Benjamin must be so proud...
Driving gloves taken off a particularly obnoxious detective, when we jacked his car right outside his SPPD precinct building. Fell had them customized and re-branded just for you.

Shadow Strike don't come out to play that often, but when they do you can bet the G-Kings snag their gear as trophies. This glove was customized by Skin Deco. Wear it with pride.
Black leather gloves with yellow details. Based on the colors of the garter snake - the current pet of choice for Havalynd's high rollers.

Military grade leather glove, designed with input from Kaspar Danko on what really works in the field. Not for pretty-boys and dandies.

Leather glove by FU. Chung-hee demanded pads and extra grip on the palm and fingers when he had Byeong Lee commission these. Nothing like 'em for shimmying up a fire escape.

These fingerless gloves have studs at the knuckles that will leave a hell of an impression... For an example, look online for pics of Seung Bloodrose after Orlenz' had a go at him last March.

The Urban Skater Cowboy look was created by Birth with this hat as the focal point. In an outfit full of big, bold colors the dark red and black of this item provides some visual relief.
The Defender Combat Helmet shows off a little Praetorian pride to go with your new Shadow Strike groove.
Inspire San Paro while wearing this snazzy Uncle Sam themed Stovepipe hat. Creator: Samuel Wilson

There's some crazy hair out there. But when you are trying to break into a property and retrieve a package, it's not always prudent to be sporting a big green 'fro. That's why Eliza Bathory designed this beanie hat.
East meets West in San Paro. And now also in the first ever baseball cap from South Asian label Rakshasa.
We know you are too cool to sweat. So Infamy specifically designed 'The Infamous' sweatband so that the color runs if you do. Keep your nerve or prepare to go red in the face - literally.
Fashions come and go, but Jeung's original bandana is what started the whole Blood Rose look. This is Seung's version of it. And now it’s yours.
Jeung met Jean Zasou at The Gaijin Club last month. The normally reticent and aloof Jean was excited to get into the Blood Rose market, but on one condition - to provide items only for the elite.
Zoosh retro gear. Nothing says 'classic' like a trilby; especially when it's this bright green "new 30" edition hat.
The New Cross Skate Park and G crown logos in green and red on black. They say the crown was one of Javier's first tag creations...
This cap by Welfare Case ain't gonna be in stores for another three months. That, my friend, makes you cutting edge.
Might be Grayson's gambling that originally associated the drift racing team "The Hazard" with the G-Kings, but we stick with talent when we find it. This cap especially works with the Hazard Mask.
For when the mask just isn't scary enough, Tiptoe throws on a pair of these custom devil-horns to add a final touch to the crazy psycho-bitch look.
This Shamrock themed St Patrick's day hat should help you get into the correct spirit. (If you have any doubt, that spirit is Whiskey.)
""Ophelia Customs" cap by Elite. Most people know it from the Playtoy photo shoot where San Paro's favorite car tuner pin-up wore this cap and not much else."
Designed to cover up hair that is, literally, ruined. This bandana saw the launch of the whole Ruined range.
When 'Enforcement is Everything', you may as well do it in cutting edge style. We’re product testing this new beanie hat by Conflickt, so give it a good work out.
Baseball caps just ain't professional. You may as well be wearing a lacy Easter bonnet! That what you want? Thought not. That's why Vanguard sell this military cap.
Specially designed bandana by Vanguard as part of their 'Praetorian Riotwear' range. It's a badge of honor to own one and to wear one, so treat it with respect.
Be a 'Knight of San Paro' with this exclusive baseball cap from the guys at Inside Out. Blue, grey, tough - this is the original 'Knight' item which launched the line, and it's still the best.
Exclusive Shadow Strike Attack Force bandana, now available on the streets of San Paro. But only to the elite Praetorians.
Some people regard the Prentiss Tigers as little more than a bunch of trigger-happy cowboys. FU heard about it and helpfully made these cowboy hats so the Tigers could live up to the reputation.
Make the old folk feel safe and secure by wearing this vintage-styled Prentiss All Star headwear. If you want to get ahead, get a hat.
Droit de Seigneur created an amazing print design for this navy baseball cap; wear it backwards and show off their logo.
Darryl Kent is a big fan of Hard Tackle's baseball cap; it's rare to see him without one during the week. Play hard, and play to win - a sentiment he likes.
Ninjette's angry ape knit hat. Dark for night-time stealth work, but still branded... We're not those no-class Praetorians, after all.
Simon Tran started the 'I get my workout through Crim beat-downs' look. This band pads your forehead if you're masked, and keeps it sweat- and hair-free if you're not.

The "C.S.A. Sting" line's distinctive "Fist Pump" logo makes sure anyone who sees you in this smart military cap knows exactly which side of the fence you came down on. Enforcement is everything, baby.
Happy Valentine's Day from all at Reloaded Productions.
A Joker branded Trillby Hat. Stylish, classic and utterly psychotic. Sums up San Paro nicely.
Silver jewelry; always a classic. Also, these spooky little earrings are good for fending off upside-down vampires.
This simple wristwatch is by Villainy. The blurb on their website reads; be careful wearing it. The red is so bright traffic will stop in all directions.
Normal bullet bracelets use dummy ammo. Normal ain't our thing. This one's made from used casings - all of them fired at a Blood Rose and missed. Those 'Forcers can't hit shit.

Tyron Sennet has sent down word that short chains such as this should be standard wear. Four Roses have been killed in past month when their long chains snagged during the struggle to escape exploding cars.
We hear that punk could be coming back - in a remixed style called NuPunk. Get ready for it by wearing this.
A black carbon fiber earring. Very light and very strong - for the man of action.
Seung used to have a funky little twin-pointed beard. He spent more time trimming it than looking after business. These twin chin piercings are much lower maintenance.
A black earring made of carbon fiber, which makes it both light and strong. These were originally worn by Seung before he moved to Havalynd.

Yin-Yang earrings, as worn by Jeung last month and now released to be worn by elite Blood Rose members. Jeung said they represented the interconnectivity and symbiosis between Criminals and Enforcers. Whatever.

The flagship Cabra Bara product. Everything they stand for in one item. Dangerous, stylish and understated - as understated as a kick-ass black and red leather armband can be, of course.
The spike stud earring - as favored by Seung himself. But don't let that put you off. They are actually as hot as Hades.

You never know whether to believe half of this crap - but the myth has it that this was originally the collar from Charlotte's little Maltipoo dog. Given to Jeung and passed on to Seung - perhaps ironically.
As part of Simeone's elite you can't have any form of ID on you. Ever. Only Michael knows which dog tag numbers match each person. Demonstrate your loyalty and wear it on the outside.
You've got a price on your head. Celebrate by lowering a dollar necklace over it.
Money is the root of all evil. So wear this dollar ring with pride.
Platinum inverted cross earring, aka The Cross of St. Peter: a symbol of humility and unworthiness. Make sure that's exactly what the Enforcers feel.

Simeone says we are his avenging angels. As such he had these platinum skull rings made especially.
Small platinum ring. Picked out for you by Charlotte. Be a shame to let the girl down.
The black and blue check pattern is quintessential G-King fashion. The perfect wrist accessory to accompany a finger flipped at the CSA.
Throw your middle fingers up! One of these days they'll put LEDs in these rings just so SPPD 'copters can feel the love too.

Nothing like adding a little unexpected weight behind your punch: these bullet casings were hollowed out and filled solidly in with a solder-like alloy. Looks nice. Breaks teeth.
San Paro is one big china shop, ready to get smashed the fuck up by anyone bull-crazy enough to bring it on. That's where you come in. Stick this ring through your nose and go break some shit!
A 24-carat gold chain. Not too over-the-top.  Next stop: platinum.
A garish band with seven metal studs... Sounds like one of Veronika Lee's parties.
