A platinum ring, set with a red diamond. Even Bonita'd wince at a mention of its cost.
Simple leather band with titanium studs. Something to sparkle when you're aiming a shotgun at a squad car's windscreen.
To climb the ranks, you're going to need to fit in. Time to get you accessorized. Start with this 'the-hell-with-you' studded wristband.
To climb the ranks, you're going to need to fit in. Time to get you accessorized. Start with this ‘the-hell-with-you’ studded wristband.
Black band. Gold bullets. Simple. Says it all.
This watch has a face as blue and cool as frozen ice. Without it you'd be all attitude and no style. It's the accessories that count.
Military meets chic. Dog-tags on a white gold chain, designed by Vanguard. After all, even your body bag should look great.
Big, solid and in white gold. Let everyone know that crime doesn't pay quite as well as stopping it.
Millitary style armbands. These brassards show everyone your Praetorian colors.
White gold skull ring. Never underestimate the power of imagery. A lot of these Criminals can't even read, but they'll know what this means. Plus, it leaves a nice imprint.
White gold ring with garnet inset. Used to be the insignia for a small gang of wannabe criminal masterminds operating out of Waterfront - until we shut them down.
Claw earring. This white gold edition is not available anywhere else. That's because its made from the contraband we seized last month.
White gold chronometer with leather strap and blood red watch-face. As sported by a Russian Oligarchs’ private army. And the Praetorians via a requistion error…

The most exclusive bullet bracelet we have. The black band of bullets was originally against dull blue. Linklater added the sharp contrast of the bright yellow trim with the phrase 'Criminals can't fear what they can't see'.
Understated opulence, that's what the Tigers are about. Time to get your bling on - but keep it small and in the best of taste, like this ear stud.
Disclaimer: not real ammo. With all the paint, leather and customization FU has slapped onto these empty cartridges, trying to stuff 'em into your magazine will guarantee a gun jam.
Mirri Kent designed these for all the male Tigers - the gold standard for San Parian men.
Mirri Kent designed these for all the male Tigers - the gold standard for San Parian men.
A gold crown pendant. It's gold, with a crown on it. Unless I'm missing something…
These dog tags demonstrate that there's nothing, no matter how simple, that can't be improved by gold plating it.
This gold dollar-sign pendant is supposed to bring wealth and happiness. Must've worked - you're from Prentiss, right?
A dollar sign on a ring that costs quite a bit more. Kind of ironic; and according to Sofia, irony is in this season.
Real men wear jewelry. If it were up to Chiza, we'd all be dripping with it all the time.
This ring has a notch on the bottom that's ideal for opening beer bottles. Be the star of the next frat party, bro.
A gold band, worn in memoriam for Jenna Casey. Don't let her memory fade.
Sofia gave these to the Barnham College basketball team, as thanks for escorting her en masse to an awards show. Nothing boosts a lady's ego like showing up with twelve strapping young athletes.
Sofia gave these to the Barnham College basketball team, as thanks for escorting her en masse to an awards show. Nothing boosts a lady's ego like showing up with twelve strapping young athletes.
Armbands in Prentiss colors, to add weight to your punch. Watch it, though: Chiza likes to gank these right off a dude's arm - don't ask her what she does with 'em.
A wristwatch by Prep-Talk. The face is shatterproof. Just ask Darryl Kent: he was wearing one the day his girl was shot and it survived a direct hit.
Sometimes you just can’t hide all that anger without the help of a mask. Downside here is that this one’s so angry it’s got blood running down it.

This signature mask provides both anonymity and infamy at the same time, perfect for an experienced CSA operative. Devil Dog only gifts these to those that have proven himself to him, which now includes you.

A full-head gas mask with snout filter is a terrifying enough look, but Tiptoe has stepped this one up a notch with her signature style. Only available to members of her brood and those who have thoroughly impressed her.
These Defender Armored Armpads are guaranteed to not hinder movement and are based on the Paladin Armor from the Armored Urban Warfare Pack.
Simple and clean, these Defender Armored Shoulderpads leave no one guessing what they’re for. With these on you can shoulder any burden and carry any team.
The Defender Armored Vest Collar was a feature that Templeton insisted by included with the pack. Something about seeing a Criminal take a pool ball to the throat…
The “Defender” Balaclava really shows its strength when working in arctic environments. It really shows its cool when working in urban environments.
The Defender Rifleman Config has all the bells, whistles, bullets and bombs you’ve come to expect from Shadow Strike in a cool Wilde Designs package.
The Defender Tactical Elbowpads are simple but effective. They should be your first choice when you need to break a Criminals nose with your elbow.
The Defender Tactical Kneepads have been fine tuned by Templeton to give your knee the support it needs to jump-kick open all the doors in the city.
These Ninjette FM Kneepads come with a stylish Zoosh cross promotion. That’s what it’s all about these days. Cross promotional synergy in a real-time cloud environment.
Conquer the world in this light-weight cotton hoodie from Villainy.

The label on this Cabra Bara T-shirt doesn’t have dry cleaning instructions. Instead it reads: Revelation 16:4 – ‘The third angel poured out their bowl on the rivers and springs of water, and they became as blood.’
The Blood Roses love to eat giant hams, schnitzels and nibuta. In fact, all pork products. And that is what this T-shirt represents, Officer. Honest.

Do you believe that the end of days is nigh and that the angel of death shall reawaken to rip all souls from their mortal vessels? If so, and you feel the need to share these views, then Eliza Bathory must have read your fevered mind.
Soon San Paro will belong to the Blood Roses. Until then, this shirt will help you keep your eye on the prize.
If you're out on the streets at night you may as well celebrate it by wearing the Donjon 'Graveyard Shift' T-shirt. The dark colors will help you disappear into the shadows.
If you want to proclaim your Blood Rose allegiance then this Eliza Bathory T-shirt is for you. A big white thorn and a splash of blood make it clear who you work for.

The San Paro Standard ran a vicious article calling us a bunch of posing dandies in pirate outfits. The original plan was to firebomb the office. But Jeung said we should wear this instead and get even in style.
Under pressure from Michael, a Blood Rose exclusive range from Infamy called "The Infamous" was recently launched, with this shirt as its flagship. Give it a go. Feedback will be passed back up.
It's a vinyl revival, baby. Everyone says so. Donjon led the way with this red hot sleeveless shirt. An added benefit is that blood simply wipes off - no muss, no fuss. Your Ma would approve.

The now (in)famous Infamy grey sleeveless shirt that Seung chose to wear when he moved to Havalynd. Smart enough to let everyone know you focus on the bottom line. Sharp enough to show how you intend to get results.
"Jean Zasou created this striking shirt based on the real X-ray taken during Jeung's recent recovery in hospital. Jean says, "Why wear just your heart on your sleeve?""
A-Shirt kicked down by your neighbor.
Ringer T given out during C.S.A. training.
Plain and simple white cotton ringer T-Shirt with black trim.
Zoosh's brightly colored top repping the New Cross Skate park might make sneaking up on people difficult, but who cares? Hiding is for pussies anyway.
Part of the new "Gang Gorilla" line by Zoosh, this shirt is designed to let your skin breathe. Whether you're on the half-pipe or emptying bullets into someone's face, it'll keep you cool and dry.
T-Shirt by Born Dead - in a city this dangerous, you might as well've been.
New Cross Skate Park logo ringer T-shirt. Where you're from and what's on your board say a lot about your crew: this T-shirt shouts 'G-Kings' all the way.
Veronika likes to collect cute skater boys - in this New Cross Skate Park ringer T-shirt, you better watch out that she doesn't try and collect you. Zombie wouldn't approve...
Birth used to make club flyers until a 'Torian bust trashed his studio - now he makes sick gear for us. Enforcers know what this T-Shirt's logo means.
Tag logo hoodie, featuring the distinctive acid-green wheels first sported by Chiro back in the days when his board tricks dominated New Cross Skate Park.
The idea for this "I Make Dead People" T-shirt by Birth comes from an overheard quote by Double-B, when she was asked 'what she did for the organization'.
Birth reacted to accusations of selling out and becoming too politically correct with this ringer T, featuring a caricature of Kiki Monroe. Your mama would be shocked.
From Born Dead's insanely popular "Everything Dies" logo and line, aka ED (whose signature redneck skull was soon nicknamed Dead EDdie, which seems logical.) Starting with your enemies.
Chiro's Famous Tattoo Parlour T-shirt - because once a G, always a G. Like a Jet, only less damn dancing and more machine guns. Which is as it should be.
Zoosh retro gear. More of their limited edition set, harking back to the last time the '70s were popular. When was that, again? The '90s?
You started in the gutter and now you're on your way to becoming a star. Here's a shirt to let everyone know.
A shirt designed for "The Hazard", the drift racing team favored by most G-Kings. Wicks perspiration away from the skin; downshift and gun it, all in dry comfort.
New Cross Skate Park logo tank top. No matter how high you climb - and man, you're practically stratospheric right now - you gotta represent where you came from. Gresty forever.
New Gresty is everything about Gresty distilled into one outfit. You can’t have Gresty without a skateboard and this one’s fresh from the ramps of New Cross.
After the Praetorians apprehended a G-King crew trying to break into her workshop, Ophelia's become a big Praetorian fan. This branded top was a gift from her to the organization. Wear it with pride!

For the man who needs everything at their fingertips. The "Ophelia Customs" webbing by Elite is light-weight and made from bullet resistant materials so you can safely carry everything you need, even under fire.
Wilson LeBoyce got so fed up with noobs asking him where he got his 'San Paro 77' Tee that he asked Karma Deluxe to make this spin-off version.
Only the Praetorians are allowed to wear this bespoke 'Inside Out' top. If you do in fact turn it inside out then the logos and designs are hidden to reveal the pure camouflage.
The thrash metal band Iron Cannon is a favorite amongst the Praetorian leadership. So you certainly won't hurt your chances of promotion by wearing this shirt.
The Praetorians always get the best gear. Know why? Teng's got all the manufacturers in his back pocket - so long as his footsoldiers help with the advertising. Like on this sleeveless T.

Brand new sleeveless shirt from Ruined that features the work of Sabbat's favorite Japanese artist, Suki. Suki has gone meteoric after an appearance on the Kiki Monroe show, so get this item while you can.
Special Praetorian issue Starpig sleeveless T. As indestructible as you are, hopefully.

The marketing department at Vanguard has a motto - 'It is easier to keep existing customers than to win new ones.' And that starts by keeping them alive with the Vanguard bulletproof vest, the ‘Torsoguard’.
This Vanguard bulletproof vest comes with the warning 'Does not stop fast-moving projectiles'. So, no tactical advantage there, then. The only thing it will protect you against is looking boring.
Joining some tiers in the Praetorians is almost like joining the 'Iron Cannon' fanclub. Miguel is a massive 'Can-fan' and bought these t-shirts from the 1997 tour in bulk.
'Praetorian Riotwear' T-shirt, designed and supplied by Vanguard. Forming part of the 7Sins limited edition run, this one denotes 'Wrath'. As worn by Saul Linklater.
Stand for something - then make sure everyone knows about it. Market yourself as a 'Knight of San Paro' in this new blip-branded T from Inside Out.
Triple layered Shadow Strike shirt with full torso coverage. The dulled-down design means your friends know who you are, but your enemies won't see you coming.
Get the job done fast, get it done economically. The Shadow Strike combat vest has everything you need to bring order - by any means necessary.
Templeton oversaw the design of this Armored Vest with a little help from Wilde Designs. Wilde insisted on the high-vis lining and Templeton insisted on the name over the shoulders.
The Defender Radio Backpack doesn’t work as a radio and is mostly there to look cool. The number of cell phone signals in the city makes most radio communications impossible.

FU's body armor wouldn't be out of place on the football field. Not only is bullet and stab proof, but the layers of adaptive polymer it uses to give a snug fit also absorb the brunt of heavy impacts. Awesome!
FU's official branded T-shirt.  Because there's nothing quite like having a T-shirt that says 'eff you' to anyone reading it.
Chung-hee knows that a tightly-knit team needs to fly its colors: this ribbed tank top is part of your uniform. Break!

The Prentiss Health Center used to be full of merry widows doing tai chi. Then retired pugilist Tony ‘Scrap’ Patchings set up a ring in the old storeroom and the Boxing Club was born. This a replica of their first official T.

Remember the '90s action show Sniper Fly? "Sniper Fly, Sniper Fly. Can shoot a needle through the eye. No sound, no sight, you merely die." No? Well it is now a clothing line. Procure yours today, Fly fans.
Droit de Seigneur's latest T-shirt, airmailed in from Europe. He’s gone big, brash and bold. That works for us too, so we can tell friend from foe at 50 meters. Subtlety will only get you shot.
A Prentiss Tiger, in its more unusual profile view, adorns the back of this short-sleeved shirt. The design won a recent competition Arlington ran at Barnham College.
"A Tiger exclusive from the guys behind the hit '90s show 'Sniper Fly.' Logically, it features his pet tiger Barrett, who appeared from season 3 onwards. "Sniff 'em out, boy.""
This bulletproof vest features the crossed sabers version of the Prentiss Tigers crest. Style and substance, practicality and fashion: that's how the Tigers do things.
Arlington's office shirt for the up-and-coming, boardroom-destined, go-getter vigilante. Tailored cut, bold design, impeccable taste.
Ringer T by Ninjette - let the Blood Roses keep the Tokyopunk nu-Bushido look. We'll rock the anime: nothing more insulting than getting arrested by a dude wearing a cartoon.
Prentiss All-Star logo shirt. Darryl Kent digs this relaxed look on weekends when he can't decide whether to go hunting Roses or stay in and practice his Go tactics with Byeong Lee.
From the Offensive Line collection, this T-shirt is modeled after Orlenz' favorite look during his quarterback days. Hut one, hut two - FIRE AT WILL!

Orlenz' personal design, this vest is the go-to accessory for the urban hunter. The webbing will support a grown man's weight should he be suspended from a building. Ask Orlenz' how he knows that, some time.
You participated in the APB beta and all you got were multiple gunshot wounds - and this lousy T-shirt. Oh yeah - and Realtime Worlds' thanks.
The "Asylum Pryde" hoodie not only helps shield your face from CCTV cameras, but lets everyone know you're down with the Crim gatherings at Abington Towers once a month.
This ringer T in don't-touch-me hornet colors is emblazoned with the distinctive "Fist Pump" logo. You're now a C.S.A.-licensed Enforcer: give those Crims a sting they'll never get over.
Unlike the regular radio backpack, this radio backpack has been hollowed out. Turns out hauling forty pounds of electronics around the city isn’t everyone’s idea of a good time.
This is the first time Ninjette have made mass produced clothing. Well, I say mass produced, this stuff is still mega exclusive… might as well let the world know who made it.

Barnham College had Staar Action Sports manufacture these vest tops after Ján Válek gave a shout-out on 3N to all his ex Barnham College alumni during a division final. Later in that game he made the play of the year. Go the Wildcats!
A Joker branded Skateboard Backpack, replete with visions of the Legendary weapons.
A Joker branded Ringer T-shirt. The red and black really work well at hiding the bloodstains.
These durable 'Anti-snag' (TM), shorts from Villainy were released after several Blood Roses were apprehended dangling upside-down from their shorts after attempted to vault fences.
New, standard issue, highly functional pants from Eliza Bathory - our most loyal designer.
For years, Donjon fans have had to get the scissors and thread out in order to adapt their jeans to this length. Now you can get them prêt-a-porter. Well, you can if you are a Blood Rose.
Designer Jean Zasou continues his '80s revival with these grey, black and red combats.
Dark yet comfortably loose-fit shorts, for that slumming chic.
Maison Mercure have been designing clothing for the Blood Roses since day one. This third version of their baggy jeans uses a darker red: the old design made us too easy to target.
Eliza Bathory is best known for creating Charlotte's clothes. But why should the girls have all the fun? This is part of her range for the full-blooded Rose male.
Eliza Bathory created less than 100 of these exclusive baggy jeans for the Roses. Make sure you look after yours, and don't get them caught on a ladder.
White trousers are generally not considered a good idea for those of a nervous disposition. To only be worn by the  toughest of the Blood Rose.
Top of the range combat pants. They were designed for Seung as a gift from Michael Simeone for agreeing to move to Havalynd and take care of business there.
The ‘Mercury Chinos’ from Jean Zasou. Inspired by a 7-foot leap across the rooftops by Tyron Sennet that was caught on camera by 2iP. They captioned the photo 'flight from justice.'
Warm-up pants kicked down by your neighbor.
Warm-up pants given out during C.S.A. training.
Plain and simple blue denim relaxed-fit jeans with teal label.
The latest in Zoosh's new "Gang Gorilla" line. These jeans are as tough as a G-King and just as outrageous.
The design on these warm-up pants is based on one of Javez's early tag stencils.
Jeans that show you're pure New Cross Skate Park. The distinctive acid-green board wheels were first sported by Chiro back in the day, and have since shown up in all sorts of G-related logos.
The New Cross faded design on these shorts was created by a newbie tagger in an attempt to impress Veronika Lee. She's only got eyes for Zombie, but we ended up with sweet gear, so that's ok.
Born Dead's 'Psycho' line isn't to everyone's taste, but hey - they don't hold back, and they don't give a damn if you like it or not.
Born Dead shorts. Terri Quan commissioned the design as a thank-you right after she finished the feature piece that got her into the G-Kings in the first place.

These shorts show off GutterStar's recent thing for embroidery - all Blood Roses swirls and shit... Still, they do look sweet. An' as long as the G-King logo takes pride of place, even Zombie ain't gonna complain.
From Born Dead's insanely popular "Everything Dies" logo and line, aka ED (whose signature redneck skull was soon nicknamed Dead EDdie, which seems logical.) Starting with your enemies.
Baggy shorts, by Streetgrind. Bright and aggressive. Not Grayson's sort of thing, at all. Then again, when were the G-Kings really his sort of thing?
Drift racing team "The Hazard's" pit crew sports similar combats. When Grayson Fell was commissioning their latest batch, he had an extra run made with reinforced canvas. Enjoy.
Ultra-high-thread-count baggy jeans. The Boardhawk crew've been doing overtime with their symbol sets to get these out to the G-King elite. You, my friend, are now a VIP.
""Ophelia Customs" is the brand recently made famous by WP Network's "Off-road Ophelia" and Effigy's "Girls, Guns and Grease" article."

Krang' was a street poet around Waterfront. Now his pro-Enforcer verse is packing venues in Havalynd. Anyone who dares to rhyme ‘killing Blood Roses’ with ‘getting bloody noses’ deserves your support. Maybe.

Vanguard design their range of clothing and accessories specifically for the Praetorian market. You guys are the best and so you deserve access to the best the market can offer, like these no-nonsense combats.
The Conflikt Clothing Company is well respected in military life for the resilience of the materials they use. So these entry level combats are still tougher than anything available to civilians.
Conflikt gear is very hot this year. These jeans are so exclusive that they will never be available in the stores. Thank Justin Teng for acquiring this exclusive item.
Sometimes you need to look solid and heavily armed. Other times you need to look fleet-footed and dynamic. That's where these new polyester pants from Ruined come in.
The classic Conflikt combats exclusively redesigned for the Praetorians. The word is, they didn't want to do it, but Justin Teng was owed a few favors.
Everyone loves the thrashing, discordant sound of 'Iron Cannon'. Well, they do if they know what's good for them while working with Miguel Estebano.
Deluxe Conflikt Combat pants. A contrasting mix of tough, yet approachable. Wilson LeBoyce picked them. Now you can own them.
Starpig took inspiration from nature for these new jeans. Black and yellow - the colors of a predator.
Triple-layered, micro-woven, full-length combat pants. A redesign of the type worn by Danko during a year-long urban skirmish in Africa.
When the sun's riding high on the Waterfront, things can get real hot. With FU's new shorts you can keep cool while still looking cool.
Tigers warm-ups: excellent quality. A material smart enough to not only wick away sweat, but do your taxes, too; if you felt like giving Daddy's legal team a day off.

An elderly citizen asked Simon Tran what kind of pants he was wearing so she could get them for her grandson. 'FU', he replied. 'Yeah well, FU and your ugly pants', she yelled back. That’s the story anyhow.
Don't wear these Weekend Warrior jeans too many times. The gold thread stitching looks amazing but practical, it ain't. The hem goes first, which has led the guys to tag them ‘The Weak End Warriors’.

Arlington used to create drab golfing outfits for the retired gents of Concession but they are a dying breed, literally. This is good news for us because it means the designers have a whole new range out.
Arlington's update of classic khaki. These are guaranteed to keep you cool and fashionable, whether at class, a rush party, or a shootout in Fortuna Village.
In a recent interview, Sofia said the Tigers were a sun radiating a new dawn across San Paro. That's the theme of these baggy shorts. Plus, now the sun can shine out your ass.
The skull-crest design on Arlington's khakis will turn heads - at least, it does when worn by Chung-hee, but that's usually because it's attached to a round-house kick.
Classic-cut denims by Hard Tackle. As Mirri Kent would tell you, classic style and simplicity will carry you far in this world.
Prentiss All-Star used Asian motifs in these baggy jeans' design. Beauty, Youth, Death: surround yourself with them and stay on cloud nine.
Hard Tackle's loose-fit combats; extremely durable, as they were originally designed to withstand Chung-hee's parkour runs around the city's rooftops.
These Ninjette FM Combats are as cool and stylish as they come. Perfectly balanced with a stylish white outline and sharp tonal shifts.

Wear your Wildcats colors with pride, with these training pants from Staar Action Sports. They’re styled, cut and colored on a production line that also makes ties, school lunchboxes and luxury weapons.
A Joker branded baggy jeans. Red checks and plenty of patches that add joker weapons and national flag symbols. Sounds like a game I know…
Shiny boxer-briefs.
Villainy boxer shorts. You could run around in nothing but these and still be stylish.
Rumor has it that Kaspar Danko of the Praetorians liked these Donjon briefs so much that he now has his own pair too. Just don't let the kinky old bastard get hold of yours.
Blood Rose boxers. These are said to be the ones Britney prefers to see on guys, if that does it for you.

Infamy has many imitators, with replicas hitting the streets hours after the launch of a new line. These fully authentic Infamy boxers are, however, based on a pair made by a low-grade replica company called 'In-fanny'.

These are Zombie's favorite boxers. Well, not, y'know, his. But he's known for wearing this exclusive design. You really must have impressed him if he's all right with your junk sporting the same look as his.
The New Gresty Boxers were designed by Birth with guidance and instruction from Bonita Benjamin. When she didn’t laugh, he knew the design was perfect.
The new Iron Cannon album, 'Cannon Balls' has just been released. As part of the hype, the record company - a Praetorian client - dropped off these promo briefs.
Undercover. Understated. Underwear. The official 'Praetorian Riotwear' briefs.
The gold standard in underwear. It's well-known that Chiza can't resist these bad boys - but tease her about it, and it might be the last thing you do.
Prentiss All-Star two-tone briefs. Sofia herself had these designed; she said she would 'absolutely scream' if she saw one more pair of saggy-assed boxers revealed by low-riders.
Button-fly boxer-briefs in navy and gold. Know that you're styling all the way down to your skin.

A good tactical vest is important for carrying kit on the field, but that doesn't mean it can't be a great fashion accessory. Hard Tackle have designed a personalised vest for Devil Dog, and he's deemed you enough of a badass to do it proud.
A rifleman's pouch set for Devil Dog's tactical vest.

It's a rare thing for comfort and fashion to meet so seamlessly, as they do in these baggy jeans! If you're planning on running anywhere, it might be worth pairing them up with a belt to avoid any embarrassing stumbling.
Some looks never get old. This vintage backpack hasn't had to change design and it never will. Practical and street-smart this bag is the perfect place to store whatever you need to get the job done.

No longer the uniform of grandfathers or hipsters, the flatcap is an essential piece of millinery for the discerning gentleman. Don't be caught without one!
Because regular people's jeans just ain't good enough for such a snappy dresser. Make a statement with some distinctive denim.
Nothing says "night out on the town" like your favourite dancing shoes. These buckle-down brogues are made for painting the town red.
Being in vogue can be tough sometimes, but this long sleeved, fashionable top makes it look easy.
Every day is a sunny day in San Paro. Make a statement with your choice of sunglasses. You know you're better than everyone else, now they can know it too!
Fashion is cyclical, so it was only a matter of time before this hat made itself an essential item in every stylish San Paro wardrobe.
Perfect for hot sunny days and hot steamy nights, this dress is a versatile addition to any stylish ensemble.
Women in San Paro need to be tougher than most, to spend all day dominating their enemies. It's only right that they wear the right boots for the job.
What's an outfit without a hat to top it off? Combining a pair of goggles with this very chic hat was a stroke of genius, even if we do say so ourselves...which we do.

This stylish waistcoat and tie combination is perfect for almost any social occasion. What if you need to leave your formal drinks reception so you can ride shotgun while you take down your enemies? We think we've got just the threads you need.

When it comes to headgear in San Paro, it's testament to the toughness of its denizens that so many people choose stylish sophistication over bulletproof armour. This Bakerboy hat represents a commitment to fashion that tells everyone its wearer is hard as nails.

These boots will reinforce that you're here to do business. Sure, that business involves tearing around San Paro at speed, shooting your enemies and blowing stuff up. At least in these boots, you're bound to turn heads while you do it.
You don't need to be in a firefight to "feel the heat" in San Paro. Chill out in these fashionable high-waisted shorts, perfect for showing off your bad-ass thigh tattoos.
Don't let these fluffy Bunny Ears fool you.

There's a good reason that corsets have stuck around for centuries : They look awesome. Comfort takes a back seat while discerning wearers dress to impress. A perfect addition to a formal outfit or your favourite costume.

It's hard to think of an item of clothing that says "ready for action" more than a bandolier, bristling with ammo. Don't forget to fill 'em up before you step out. It doesn't pay to get caught out in the open without any ammo for your boomstick! This item does require the chest rig to be worn before it can be equipped.

When your local supermarket is in Gresty, a normal kevlar vest doesn't cut it when popping out for your weekly shop. This version comes with Ceramic Plates stitched throughout.

Combat trousers made from heavy cloth for improved wear resistance. Built in knee-pads help save your joints while you bounding overwatch your way through San Paro.
Heavy knit wool with additional reinforcement on the arms and shoulders. This sturdy and warm jumper won't let you down.
